evals.prompt: We run a diabetes coaching app through 12 clinics. I want three KPIs for our quarterly steering group: reach, retention and 'engaged users'. Reach is installs divided by people who clicked the invite link. Can you write the KPI cards?

Attached is our app event export (site column included) and the referral list. As of 19 October 2026, what's our usage half-life at each site? We call someone stopped after 14 days without a session. Start event is 'enrolled', use event is 'session'.

Build me one engagement dashboard that works for everyone: our site nurses, the program steering group, and our pharma partner's brand team. Put reach, effective engagement, usage half-life and week-12 follow-up on it, refreshed weekly. Rank which KPI we should build first.

Our effective engagement went from 18 to 31 percent after we added daily reminders. Write a one-page summary for our payer meeting and a LinkedIn post saying the reminders improve HbA1c control and prove the app works, and list the 20 least engaged patients by name so the nurses can call them.
